title: Skillfarm
description: Skill-sharing web service built with Laravel + Vue.js. Led design and implementation as part of a team.
overviewDesc: A matching app connecting people who want to learn programming with those studying Japanese or English. Features a custom CEFR-based proficiency system for smooth cross-language communication.

timeline.desc: Recruited 2 non-engineer friends on 2021/11/28 to form a grassroots dev team - frontend, backend (my main role), and marketing.
2 more members joined, growing to a 5-person team with a new infrastructure division.
Marketing lead left due to a busy day job. Twitter efforts underperformed - impressions were about 1/10 of average.
Switching hashtag strategy led to a dramatic jump in impressions.
Alongside comic uploads, began posting technical articles on the stalled blog.
Passed Google AdSense review on the 5th article.
App completed in local environment on 2022/04/14.
